Spacious 3-Bedroom Loft Apartment in Sadaf 7, JBR | Panoramic Views & Prime Location

Welcome to your dream home in the highly sought-after Sadaf 7, located in the heart of Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) — one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront communities.

This expansive 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment spans 2,314.99 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space, offering an exceptional combination of comfort, style, and panoramic views.

Key Features:

⦁ Generous Layout: Well-planned floor-plan maximizing space and natural light.
⦁ Bright Living & Dining Area: Open, airy interiors ideal for both everyday living and entertaining guests.
⦁ Modern Kitchen: Fully equipped kitchen with quality fittings and ample storage.
⦁ Master Suite: Spacious master bedroom with built-in wardrobes and an elegant ensuite bathroom.
⦁ Additional Bedrooms: Two additional bedrooms perfect for family, guests or a home office.
⦁ Contemporary Bathrooms: Stylish, modern finishes and high-quality fixtures.
⦁ Balcony with Views: Relax and enjoy calming views — city, sea, or skyline depending on orientation.
⦁ Parking: Allocated covered parking for convenience.


Community & Lifestyle:

Located in JBR’s vibrant Sadaf district, this apartment offers direct access to:

⦁ The Beach and waterfront promenade
⦁ Cafés, restaurants & retail outlets
⦁ Leisure & fitness facilities
⦁ Excellent transport links and connectivity

Perfect for families, professionals, or investors looking for a premium residence in a lively yet refined beachfront community.
